verdict.rationale: Fern documents 'Fern Agent' automations that can run on a schedule or be triggered by Slack discussions to review reader feedback/questions and open PRs when a described change is needed, which is a form of event-triggered automation (fern-docs-8, fern-docs-25, fern-docs-45). However, this is limited to Fern's own docs-maintenance domain (feedback, search queries, Slack) rather than a general rule engine for arbitrary events/actions. Missing for 10: a configurable rules/trigger system spanning arbitrary event sources (webhooks, API calls, custom conditions) and arbitrary actions beyond PR creation, plus independent confirmation of reliability.
